info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Customer Products Management API
info.description: The Customer Products Management API enables businesses to seamlessly retrieve product details associated with their customers. It provides access to important product information, allowing users to manage customer-related offerings effectively. Typical consumers of this API include customer service representatives and financial advisors who require quick access to product data to assist clients. This endpoint is designed to enhance customer relationship management by ensuring up-to-date information is readily available for decision-making.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve a list of products associated with a specific customer ID, providing detailed information about each product.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the customer product information for a specific customer identified by the customer ID 'CUST-100045'. Ensure that the request is made with valid authentication tokens and any required parameters.

200.description: The request was successful, and the response contains the requested customer product details.

GetCustomerProductsByIdRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for retrieving customer product details in JSON format.

GetCustomerProductsByIdResponse_200.title: Customer Product Response

partyId.description: Identifier for the party associated with the customer.

productCode.description: Code representing the specific product associated with the customer.

effectiveDate.description: The date when the product became effective for the customer.

relationshipTier.description: The tier level of the customer's relationship status.

recordStatus.description: Current status of the customer product record.

version.description: Version number of the customer product record.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the record was last updated.

GetCustomerProductsByIdResponse_200.description: Schema representing the response for customer product retrieval operations.
